nodes.name: Form Trigger
nodes.notes: Standalone test harness (ADR-020) ONLY: paste a task id; Get Task self-fetches ALL attachments. Unified reader (ADR-036 'Input readers unified') classifies each: image -> image block (URL passthrough, no Docling), else -> Docling text block. Attach mixed files freely.

parameters.formDescription: Enter a ClickUp task id to extract its attachments into the block contract.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Production entry (called by Stage A, Block 5). In: { clickup_task_id } ONLY - the reader SELF-FETCHES the task (router retired, ADR-036 'Input readers unified'). Out: { blocks, clickup_task_id, warnings }. PURE function: no side-effects - Stage A fires `warnings` via Post Alert (v1) (single alerting choke-point).

nodes.name: Get Task
nodes.notes: Self-fetch the authoritative attachment list via HTTP (ADR-019; the n8n ClickUp 'get' node omits attachments[]). Now on BOTH paths (Form + When Called) - the router was retired (ADR-036), so the reader fetches its own task from { clickup_task_id }.

nodes.name: Explode Attachments
nodes.notes: Pure NORMALIZER: explode the self-fetched ClickUp task's attachments[] into one item each, normalizing raw ClickUp {id,url_w_query,extension,mimetype}. Assigns GLOBAL order by index (the reader owns ordering now - router retired). 'url' serves BOTH as the image-block ref AND the fetch URL (verified downloadable, auth:none, Block 2). ZERO attachments -> emits one `_passthrough` sentinel (order -1) so the chain still reaches Aggregate Blocks; a 0-item Explode would skip every downstream node and silently null the whole pipeline (no reply/status/cost) - the bug fixed 2026-06-11.

nodes.name: Classify Attachment
nodes.notes: Route by type (ADR-036 unified reader). Output 0 (image): mime image/* OR ext png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp/bmp/svg/tiff/heic OR the `_passthrough` sentinel (no-attachment case) -> Build Image Block (no I/O, skips Fetch+Docling). Output 1 (fallback 'extractable'): everything else -> Fetch->Docling. The sentinel rides the image (no-I/O) branch on purpose so it reaches Aggregate without a bogus fetch.

nodes.name: Build Image Block
nodes.notes: Image branch: NO I/O. `_passthrough` sentinel (no attachments) -> emit a block-less item { clickup_task_id } so Aggregate (which filters items without `block`) still runs and returns blocks:[]. Otherwise an already-attached image is ClickUp-hosted -> emit { type:image, ref:url, mime, source:input, source_ref:att_id, alt:title }. Missing url -> [BRAK: image_ref_missing] + warn. Same envelope as Build Text Block so Aggregate is uniform.

nodes.name: Fetch Attachment Binary
nodes.notes: Extractable branch only. Download bytes to a binary property (kept separate from JSON - no base64 in the flow). ClickUp url is pre-signed, so no auth header. continueRegularOutput: a fetch failure stays inline (no binary) so Docling/Build Text Block degrade it to [BRAK] + warning.

nodes.name: Docling Convert
nodes.notes: POST /v1/convert/file (multipart field 'files'). image_export_mode=placeholder is CRITICAL (default 'embedded' inlines base64 and explodes token cost - ADR-036 Block 1). A corrupt file returns HTTP 200 with status=failure + md_content=null, so Build Text Block checks md_content, not the HTTP code. continueRegularOutput keeps real HTTP errors inline -> [BRAK].

nodes.name: Build Text Block
nodes.notes: Extractable branch per-item: success -> { type:text, order, md }; any failure (fetch error, Docling error, or 200/status=failure/empty md) -> [BRAK: extraction_failed <file>] + needs_alert + warn_source. Flags has_embedded on placeholder markers (embedded in-doc images dropped+warned - hosting is Block 10). warn_source/needs_alert/has_embedded drive the `warnings` Aggregate hands to Stage A.

nodes.name: Merge Branches
nodes.notes: Converge the image-passthrough branch (input 0) and the Docling-extract branch (input 1) into ONE stream so Aggregate keeps a SINGLE input (a run-once-for-all-items node with N input connections runs once per connection and drops items - Block 2 trap, CLAUDE.md). Append = concat all items. VERIFY at build: must not stall when one branch is empty (all-text OR all-image task); if it stalls, apply ADR-036 fallback (alwaysOutputData on tails / single run-once-for-each builder).

nodes.name: Aggregate Blocks
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL (single input via Merge -> runs once over all items). Returns { blocks (sorted by order), clickup_task_id, warnings:[{source,title,err}] }. Stage A (Block 5) fires `warnings` via Post Alert (v1): each builder names its own warn_source (multimodal/extraction-failed, /image-ref-missing) + /embedded-image-skipped for dropped in-doc images. Branch-free convergence => n8n returns THIS node deterministically.

nodes.name: Lookup File Processing Config
nodes.notes: Global file-processing limits (config.zip_max_entries / zip_max_file_mb / zip_max_total_uncompressed_mb; migration 027, ADR-048 Block 1). Pivots the 3 keys into ONE typed row so Block 3's zip guards read $('Lookup File Processing Config').first().json.zip_max_*. Hung off Get Task (runs once per execution) and fed into Merge Branches so it is NOT a dangling leaf: Aggregate Blocks filters to items carrying `block`, so this row is dropped from output and Aggregate stays the sole branch-free terminal (return-value safety, CLAUDE.md). alwaysOutputData so a 0-row result still emits and never nulls the chain. Enforcement of these limits lands in Block 3 (not here).

parameters.query:
select
  max(value::int) filter (where key = 'zip_max_entries')               as zip_max_entries,
  max(value::int) filter (where key = 'zip_max_file_mb')               as zip_max_file_mb,
  max(value::int) filter (where key = 'zip_max_total_uncompressed_mb') as zip_max_total_uncompressed_mb
from config;

nodes.name: Zip Image Key
nodes.notes: ADR-048 Block 2: ENTRY of the 'Store Zip Image' step (zip-inner image branch ONLY - loose images never touch this; they keep their ClickUp URL ref). Computes the Supabase object key <clickup_task_id>/<sanitized att_id> and carries entry meta (title, order, mime) + the image binary forward. att_id arrives as `<parentAttId>:<i>` (Block 3) - sanitized to a safe key ([^A-Za-z0-9._-] -> '_'); the original att_id is preserved in json for source_ref. Binary must arrive in property `data` (Block 3's Explode Zip Entries normalizes it). The internal chain Key->Upload->Sign->Compose is wired now (Block 2); Block 3 connects Classify-inner-image -> here and Compose -> zip image block -> Merge Branches. Until then this chain has no trigger path, so it never executes - the live reader is unchanged.

nodes.name: Upload Zip Image
nodes.notes: ADR-048 Block 2: upload the ORIGINAL zip-inner image bytes to the private EU bucket `zip-inner-images` at <storage_path> via Supabase Storage REST (POST /storage/v1/object/{bucket}/{path}, x-upsert:true). Auth = predefined supabaseApi cred (service_role; bypasses RLS on the private bucket). Original size, NEVER base64 (ADR-048 Decision 3 - the heavy bytes stay out of execution data, which is the whole OOM fix). cache-control max-age=3600 (objects are purged at 24h by Block 4's pg_cron, so caching is short). continueRegularOutput: a failed upload returns no Key, so Sign/Compose yield an empty ref and Block 3 degrades that entry to a dropped block + warn rather than throwing. Gate D verified the full upload->sign->provider-fetch path end-to-end 2026-06-15.

nodes.name: Sign Zip Image URL
nodes.notes: ADR-048 Block 2: mint a signed URL (expiresIn 21600s = 6h) for the just-uploaded object (POST /storage/v1/object/sign/{Key}; Key comes from the upload response, e.g. `zip-inner-images/<task>/<att>`). The private bucket means only a signed URL is fetchable. 6h TTL outlives the reader->invoke-model gap, which in queue mode includes inter-stage queue latency, yet stays well under the 24h cleanup (ADR-048 Consequences). The provider fetches this URL through LiteLLM - gate D confirmed Gemini read the image (1089 image_tokens, correct description) 2026-06-15. continueRegularOutput + retry so a transient sign failure degrades to an empty ref rather than throwing.

nodes.name: Compose Signed URL
nodes.notes: ADR-048 Block 2: assemble the absolute signed URL (HOST + /storage/v1 + signedURL) into `ref`, and re-attach the entry meta (clickup_task_id, att_id, title, order, mime) via pairedItem from Zip Image Key (verified to survive the two HTTP hops in gate D). `ref` is the zip-inner image's downstream reference and a DROP-IN for the loose-image URL ref - Resolve Routing passes it verbatim into image_url.url, so a Supabase signed URL needs no contract change. stored=false (empty ref) signals an upload/sign failure for Block 3 to drop+warn. NEVER base64. Block 3 wraps this into the zip image block (same envelope as Build Image Block) and feeds Merge Branches.
